about: Class renames of live_label.py that may be used as training labels (detector base class>label base class). Judged by eye on runs/det_live/labels_v1/sheets/rename_*.jpg (2026-11-23, by the assistant; Sam's spot check pending). A pair not in 'ok' is painted over. Pairs with fewer than 10 labels are never used. 2026-11-23 later: Sam trusts these verdicts without a spot check. Added the pairs of the released matches 104801 m3 and m4 (sheets in runs/det_live/labels_v1x/sheets/): ok golden-knight>rune-giant, knight>mini-pekka, miner>mini-pekka, royal-recruit>mini-pekka, giant>rune-giant, mega-minion>minion-giant, royal-recruit>little-prince, ram-rider>prince, goblin-brawler>mini-pekka, skeleton-dragon>minion-giant; no golden-knight>minion-giant, royal-recruit>prince, ram-rider>little-prince, princess>little-prince, royal-ghost>mini-pekka. data/det/live_r5 was built before this addition.
